headline: The HCPS Business Solutions Hub
lead: Value-added business services for HomeCare Provider Services dealers — beyond our manufacturer product lines. Access vetted partners, tools, and solutions designed to strengthen your business, improve cash flow, streamline operations, and support long-term growth. Separate from our manufacturer portfolio, and exclusive to the HCPS dealer network.

partners.name: CardChamp
partners.service: Credit card processing with fully compliant surcharging
partners.benefit: Offset processing fees so you keep more of every sale — 0% processing with compliant surcharging.
partners.hcps_advantage: A preferred HCPS partner with a dealer-specific enrollment page; HCPS is credited for every referral.
partners.tagline: Turn Credit Card Fees into Cash Flow
partners.summary: Most HCPS dealers are overpaying on credit card processing. CardChamp shows you how much — and helps you keep it — with fully compliant surcharging built for small-to-medium businesses.
benefits: 0% credit card processing with compliant surcharging
Set up your account in under 15 minutes
Personal support you can depend on
partners.cta_secondary: See how much your business is overpaying in processing fees.
partners.referral_note: Applications and enrollment are completed on the CardChamp page, and HCPS is credited for every referral.

partners.name: HCPS Website & Online Presence

partners.benefit: A professional web presence plus a 24/7 online ordering storefront your customers can use.
partners.hcps_advantage: Built and maintained by your HCPS team and integrated with the HCPS online ordering platform.
partners.tagline: A professional web presence, done for you

partners.cta_secondary: Ask about a website and online-ordering setup for your store.

partners.benefit: Reach more customers and drive repeat business with campaigns run for you.

partners.cta_secondary: Ask how HCPS can market your business.
